column3: “Strengthened himself” is rendered “established himself securely,” and “made him great upward” as “exalted him greatly.”
“Heads of the fathers” is rendered “heads of the fathers' households.”
“In where he had prepared” is rendered “to the place he had prepared.”
The Hebrew has “he had put”; NASB reads “was there,” as some manuscripts and ancient versions do. “Sought it” is rendered “sought it out.”
The wish “let your word be established” is rendered as a statement (“Your promise … is fulfilled”).
“Go out before this people and come” is rendered “go out and come in before this people,” and “judge” as “rule.”
“It was this with your heart” is rendered “you had this in mind,” “many days” as “long life,” and “judge” as “rule.”
“Given” is rendered “granted”; NASB supplies “has possessed” and “those who will come.”
The Hebrew reads “to the high place”; NASB reads “from the high place,” as the ancient versions do.
NASB supplies “as plentiful” twice; “the Shephelah” is rendered “the lowland.”
“The export” is rendered “were imported”; NASB spells “Kue,” and “took” is rendered “procured.”
NASB supplies “shekels” and “apiece.” “By their hand” is rendered “by the same means,” and the second “brought out” as “exported.”
